name: Two-Hour Meal Cutoff
title: Finish eating two hours before bed.
benefit: Better sleep quality and steadier morning energy.
subtitle: Meal Timing
rationale: Glucose handling is poorer at night, so ending the eating window earlier keeps digestion out of the sleep window.

evidence.summary: Glucose handling is generally poorer at night, supporting an earlier end to the eating window.

indications: Dinner lands late because the workday runs long.
Night waking or reflux follows late meals.
Morning glucose or sleep quality lags after late dinners.
